tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check Cabana pool-service coverage by five-digit US ZIP code. No address or personal data.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List supported pool services, billing periods, visit frequencies and allowed modifiers.

tools.name: estimate_pool_service
tools.description: Get a USD starting price for one pool or spa service in the ZIP's market. Without a partner key, status starting_price is a market minimum, not a personalized quote; modifiers do not change it. Approved partner keys return status estimate with an indicative total. Monthly billing differs from weekly

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "estimate_pool_service" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get an indicative USD price for one pool or spa. Monthly billing differs from weekly visits. No booking or lead is created." → after: "Get a USD starting price for one pool or spa service in the ZIP's market. Without a partner key, status starting_price is a market minimum, not a personalized quote; modifiers do not change it. Approved partner keys return status estimate with an indicative total. Monthly billing differs from weekly"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
